'''challenger Profit-needs trimming''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Published:''' 4 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]

== Strategy ==

Please help! Basic strat: Drop people, do damage, Wokling gets HP(V) for funky combos, HDWGITM searches for anything you need and is great for tracking or if you have a crummy hand, TTMaker retrieves, We’re Doomed saves. I’ve got lots of retrieval and character regeneration in here. Spread out and do damage. Also has beats on Tatooine. Major beats.
